blind_spots_patched: Baseline ch-6 cited headline Sep 2026 borrowings (Rs 620 Cr) without decomposing the severe short-term maturity mismatch funding long-lived plants, omitted Rs 511.1 Cr of unbilled contract assets (23.3% of FY26 sales under Ind AS completion accounting), missed H1 FY27's CFO drop to Rs 190.1 Cr (-Rs 371.2 Cr FCF) amid a +60.3% inventory surge, and missed India Ratings' 1.5x adjusted net leverage negative rating trigger plus the CFO's open-ended debt/equity raise stance.

Baseline ch-4 framed US trade policy purely as a one-way BIOSECURE tailwind while completely omitting US Section 232 100% patented pharmaceutical tariffs (effective Jul/Sep 2026), the August 2026 federal court injunction halting WuXi AppTec's 1260H designation ahead of the Dec 18, 2026 OMB list deadline, Sai Life's 97% foreign-currency billing exposure, and Q2 FY27 Middle East-driven solvent/chemical cost inflation.

Baseline ch-4 benchmarked Sai Life only against legacy listed peers (Divi's, Syngene, Neuland, Piramal) while completely omitting the two closest direct integrated Indian CRDMO competitors: newly listed Anthem Biosciences (higher-margin fermentation + small-molecule peer) and Hyderabad local integrated rival Aragen Life Sciences.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Sai Life has ~920 KL reactor capacity installed with a ~220 KL Bidar block commissioned and is scaling toward 1,150+ KL on schedule alongside Rs 1,100–1,300 Cr FY27 capex.

WEAKENED: Sai Life is already generating commercial premium-complexity revenue across advanced modalities including peptides (Peptide Research Center), ADCs, HPAPI, PROTACs, and oligonucleotide amidites.
WEAKENED: Operating cash conversion holds cleanly at 82%–96% of EBITDA and the balance sheet remains conservatively funded at 0.2x debt-to-equity through the FY27 capex sprint.
CONFIRMED: TPG Capital and HBM Healthcare only partially monetized their stakes in the Dec 2024 IPO Offer for Sale, leaving private-equity register transition as an open theme.
CONFIRMED: Sai Life serves 18 of the top 25 global pharma companies with clean USFDA/PMDA compliance and strong large-pharma strategic consolidation.
